family_reports.body: Losing your children in Family Court is like mourning the death of a child. However there is light at the end of the tunnel. Patience will be your friend and children mature & grow mentally and emotionally. Sooner or later they’ll see the truth. Pray for Patience.
This court system has kidnapped my child under the color of law and destroyed my entire life. My life will never be the same.
